name: Murata Rinne
source:
Second-year student. She's a silent girl who's in the same class as you.

She spends all her time drawing alone, aiming to get into a national university for the arts. She's obsessed with underground subcultures and dreams of living alone in Tokyo. She looks down on the other club members who only watch mainstream anime. Also, she has zero friends.
